newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes lower in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes lower in thin trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished slighly lower on a lacklustre Wednesday as the U.S. dollar firmed.
The rate ended at T$27.49 to the U.S. dollar against T$27.481 at Tuesday's close. The turnover was a paltry US$169.5 million, lower even than Tuesday's slack volume.
"It's a listless market," one dealer said.
The U.S. dollar climbed to a 2-1/2 year high against the yen in Europe in response to deteriorating Japanese trade position, pressuring the Taiwan unit lower.
If the U.S. dollar contines its winning streak, the Taiwan dollar could test T$27.50 or even spike to $27.51, she said.
"We don't think people will get excited," the dealer said. "Exporters would sell U.S. dollars at those levels."
